# Renewall Remodeling & Improvement

> Premier residential exterior and interior painting contractor engineered for Southwest Florida homes. Based in Cape Coral, FL.

## Overview
Renewall Remodeling & Improvement (Renewall Remodeling and Improvement, LLC) is a Florida-licensed and insured residential painting and remodeling company. Specializing in high-performance exterior painting designed to withstand Southwest Florida heat, tropical rains, salt air, and intense UV rays.

## Primary Services
- **Exterior Painting (65% Focus):** Power washing, elastomeric crack bridging, stucco restoration, masonry primer, premium weather-shield topcoats (Sherwin-Williams Loxon & SuperPaint, Benjamin Moore Aura Exterior).
- **Interior Painting (20% Focus):** Dust-controlled prep, drywall patching, zero-VOC interior finishes, baseboard and door enameling, accent walls.
- **Architectural Remodeling & Finishes (15% Focus):** Large-format tile installation, luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring, kitchen backsplash tile, commercial-grade epoxy garage floor coatings.

## Service Areas
- Cape Coral, FL (Primary Hub)
- Fort Myers, FL
- Bonita Springs, FL
- Estero, FL
- Punta Gorda, FL
- Naples, FL
- Lee County & Collier County, Southwest Florida
